title: [main] Unable to receive the material returned from subcontracting Vendor
summary: Subcontracting material returns from vendors now correctly preserve package numbers during reservation transfers and bypass unnecessary validation for zero-quantity production-order-linked lines.
key_points: Package numbers are preserved when transferring reservations for returned subcontracting materials
Receipt-balance validation is bypassed for production-order-linked subcontracting lines with zero quantities
Enables proper receipt of materials with lot and package tracking from subcontractors
quote: Preserve package numbers during reservation transfers and bypass receipt-balance validation only for production-order-linked subcontracting lines with zero base quantity
